description: Vanfretti, Luigi and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed laboratory programme uses real-time hardware-in-the-loop testing, phasor measurement units and IEC 61850 communication for monitoring, control and protection of active distribution networks. The source summarises approximately six years of laboratory work. These applications establish existing simulation-linked power-system demonstrations. They do not imply production deployment across every utility network or open access to all laboratory software and measurements. Detailed configurations remain specific to the individual examples described by the source. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-nc-nd-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
